task: Fix the invoice tax rounding defect reported by enterprise customer

defect_report.title: Invoice total is off by one cent on tax-inclusive line items
defect_report.body: When a line item has tax applied and the quantity is greater than one, the invoice total is rounded once at the end instead of per line. Enterprise customer Hexart reports a 0.01 EUR discrepancy on every invoice with more than 4 line items. Started after we migrated to Decimal in billing/invoice.py.

lines: def total(lines: list[LineItem], tax_rate: Decimal) -> Decimal:
subtotal = sum(line.unit_price * line.quantity for line in lines)

change.summary: Round each line item to cents before summing, then apply tax
change.intent: Make per-line rounding explicit so the total matches the printed lines
